notes.title: In-Development Version of Gensokyo Night Festival Now Available in Private Beta
notes.notes:
Dear all,

As previously announced, we have uploaded an in-development version of Gensokyo Night Festival to the "beta" branch as a private beta.

※※Important!※※
When we moved the project to the newest version of Unreal Engine, major bugs were created not just in the new Stage 3, but also in the previously completed and released Stages 1 and 2. Please note that since this is still an in-development build, there are numerous crash bugs, other bugs of varying severity, placeholder assets, and unfinished portions still present.

We are already aware of the bugs that occur in this game build, so there is no need to report any bugs you may find. The purpose of the beta is only to share with you our current development progress, nothing more.

In order to prevent the issues in this build from affecting existing save data, this in-development version will save in the game install folder instead of the save folder the current public build (updated up to Chapter 2) uses, so the game will start from the very beginning.

Any existing save files will not be affected.

How to get into the private beta:
Select Gensokyo Night Festival in your Steam library.
Right click on the game title on the list, or click on the gear icon on the game's page, and select "Properties...".
In "Betas", enter the following password:

　HLyAMRv7YvvZzkfV

Now, you can access the beta branch. Participate in the beta branch and update the game. You will see the word "beta" appear at the end of the game title.

■The entrance to the in-development Stage 3 can be found here. Please check the map. You will be able to enter Stage 3 from here after clearing Stage 2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/91fbee60842a71c92d3a82f17cc5fdd549d883dd.png

Once again, we apologize for the extended delay between updates. Please rest assured that the game is still in development.

We would also greatly appreciate it if you could leave your feedback and impressions of the beta in our Steam Community after playing.

We will continue to work hard on the game so that we can officially release Stage 3 for everyone to enjoy.

We hope you will continue to support Gensokyo Night Festival.

notes.title: Release of an In-Development Version of Gensokyo Night Festival
notes.notes:
To everyone looking forward to the next update for Gensokyo Night Festival,

First of all, we apologize for not posting any updates in September.
We also apologize for the ongoing delay in the release of the next game update.

tea_basira is still working on the game, but we still haven't gotten to a point where we can release a proper update.
However, as you may know, this situation has persisted for a considerable period of time.

Therefore, even though there are still many bugs and unfinished portions, we have decided to release the in-development build as a private beta on Steam to share with you our current development progress.

Important Notice
As announced in this previous Steam News post, when we moved the project to the newest version of Unreal Engine, major bugs were created not just in the new Stage 3, but also in the previously completed and released Stages 1 and 2. Please note that since this is still an in-development build, there are numerous crash bugs, other bugs of varying severity, placeholder assets, and unfinished portions still present.

When we release this private beta, we will share the password for it in a sepeate post. If you want to see our current development progress, you may try the private beta by selecting Gensokyo Night Festival in your Steam library and entering the password in Settings>Properties>Betas."
This in-development version will save in the game install folder instead of the save folder the current public build (updated up to Chapter 2) uses, so even if you have existing save files, the game will start from the very beginning.

We plan to release the in-development version private beta on October 25, 2023 (JST). When the beta goes live, we will announce the password, name of the beta branch, and where to go to start Chapter 3 in-game. We would also greatly appreciate it if you could leave your feedback and impressions of the beta in our Steam Community after playing.

We're terribly sorry for making our Early Access players wait so long for the next update,
but we hope you will continue to support Gensokyo Night Festival.

notes.title: Gensokyo Night Festival Stage 2 Update Is Here!
notes.notes:
Dear Gensokyo Fans,

The stage 2 update has finally gone live!
Thank you all so much for waiting, we have nothing but gratitude for your continued support for the project. We are so happy to be able to bring you this beautiful update that tea_basira has poured his heart and soul into, we are sure you'll enjoy it.

Stage 2 Update Summary


 The setting is the Former Capital and there is a new ability, Flare.
 There is now keyboard configuratio settings as this was an extremely popular request by users.
 There will be a mini update coming early September which will adjust the boss balance and also add an Orin/Okuu combo attack.
 There will be Touhou Project Chibi characters hidden around the Stage 2 map, if you find them you can send them to Hakurei Shrine. Can you find all of them?


[previewyoutube=Lj8NQJGKckg;full][/previewyoutube]

We are taking a vote for stage 3 update chibi characters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/72c06fc3a69323fd18453e74fe4166f525138ea4.png

One of the chibi characters in stage 3 will be decided by popular vote, the charcater with the most votes will be hidden somewhere in the stage 3 map. Stage 3 is set to take place on Youkai Mountain and Heaven.

"How to vote: Please cast your vote in the comments section of this news post, 1 account 1 vote!
*The character doesn't have to be from the Youkai Mountain or Heaven areas."

Voting closes September 21st (JST)

We are looking forward to the results!

And with that, we hope you all enjoy playing the Gensokyo Night Festival Stage 2 update!

notes.title: Gensokyo Night Festival Development Update.
notes.notes:
Dear Gensokyo Fans,

We were planning an update for Gensokyo Night festival this April, however with the current state of affairs affecting development, we regret to inform you that the update has been cancelled.
We would like to apologize to all the fans eagerly awaiting updates.

Below is an outline of the current state of development.

Map
1. Path to the Former Capital.
2. Former Capital.
3. Palace of the Earth Spirits (entrance).
Completed. 2 more levels are in development.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/05bc0277db5b1335fb4a80e7a5d8740388623ab9.gif
*In development, final product may differ.

Bosses
Okuu and Orin
Development and adjustment currently in progress.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/2c4c765481bd526a0c20843b8eea031dc079ea0a.gif
*In development, final product may differ.

Regarding the next update.
The developer has stated that it should be ready around the end of May.
We would like to push the update out in June, however taking the current situation into account this is not set in stone yet.

We have decided to keep eveyone updated every two weeks with the state of development to put everyone's minds at ease.

Tea_basira is pretty much working on this solo so we ask everyone to share their words of encouragement to help him keep soldiering on.

notes.title: To prepare for release, here is a Gensokyo Night Festival Combo Guide!!
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,

Finally we are nearing early access release.
Gensokyo Night Festival is a "2D Combo Action Game" and today we would like to introduce some of the combos you can use in game.
Check them out and mentally prepare yourself for the upcoming release!

1). Basic Combo X-X-X

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/4c4e642f67acc52227639bd94ec430c29d98640d.gif

This is the most basic combo. Can be performed by pressing X 3 times in a row.

2). Aerial Combo (While airborne)-X-X

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/d4ff3cac054c232062dd26f215da2b08871d9151.gif

The basic aerial combo. Can be performed by pressing X twice in the air.

3). Aerial Slam (While airborne)-X→↓X

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/953dd1356d5c4d20a8ab49affecda479ac098cfa.gif

A variation of the aerial combo. Combos can be altered with directional input.

To finish up, here is some info on the combos you can perform in conjunction with Suika's ability to control density and sparsity.
You can add her signature Density Charge or Sparsity Charge to regular combos for added effects.

4). Sparsity Charge Combo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/af2ef0b48abbe54201d20e51f685affe5b5d9740.gif

By charging up Sparsity first, even the basic combo becomes something more powerful.

This is just a taster of all the combos you can utilise! 
Please look forward to release!
